  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BHC Act Affiliate</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 12.23(b)(i)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Bloomberg</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means Bloomberg Index Services Limited.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrower</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; and &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowers</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; have the meanings provided in the Preamble.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrower Constituent Documents</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, as to the Initial Borrower, its certificate of formation or articles of incorporation or association, as the case may be, and its limited liability company or by-laws, as applicable.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrower Conversion Date</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the date on which the Initial Borrower converts from a limited liability company organized under the laws of the State of Maryland to a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Maryland.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrower Party</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 11.1(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowing</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a disbursement made by the Lenders of any of the proceeds of the Loans, and &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowings</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the plural thereof.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowing Base</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, at any time of determination, the sum of (a) ninety percent (90%) of the aggregate Unfunded Capital Commitments of the Included Investors, and (b) sixty-five percent (65%) of the aggregate Unfunded Capital Commitments of the Designated Investors, in each case as such Unfunded Capital Commitments are first reduced by all applicable Concentration Limits. For the avoidance of doubt, the Unfunded Capital Commitments of an Excluded Investor shall be excluded from the Borrowing Base at all times.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowing Base Certificate</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the certification and spreadsheet setting forth the calculation of the Available Commitment in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit A</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Borrowing Base Investors</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, collectively, the Included Investors and the Designated Investors.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Bloomberg Short-Term Bank Yield Index rate.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Conforming Changes</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to the use, administration of or any</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> conventions associated with BSBY or any proposed BSBY Successor Rate, as applicable, any conforming changes to the definition of &#x201c;Reference Rate&#x201d;, &#x201c;BSBY&#x201d;, &#x201c;Interest Period&#x201d;, timing and frequency of determining rates and making payments of interest and other technical, administrative or operational matters (including, for the avoidance of doubt, the definition of Business Day, timing of borrowing requests or prepayment, conversion or continuation notices and length of lookback periods) as may be appropriate, in the discretion of the Administrative Agent, to reflect the adoption and implementation of such applicable rate, and to permit the administration thereof by the Administrative Agent in a manner substantially consistent with market practice (or, if the Administrative Agent determines that adoption of any portion of such market practice is not administratively feasible or that no market practice for the administration of such rate exists, in such other manner of administration as the Administrative Agent determines is reasonably necessary in connection with the administration of this Credit </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Agreement and any other Loan Document).</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">6</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;min-height:1in;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means:</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)   &#x200b; for any Interest Period with respect to a BSBY Rate Loan, (i) to the extent a</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Borrower has elected a Loan bear interest by reference to the Daily BSBY, then the rate per annum equal to the Daily BSBY, otherwise, (ii) the rate per annum equal to the BSBY Screen Rate two (2) Business Days prior to the commencement of such Interest Period with a term equivalent to such Interest Period; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that if the rate is not published on such </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">determination date then BSBY Rate means the BSBY Screen Rate on the first (1st) Business Day</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">immediately prior thereto; and</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)   &#x200b; for any interest calculation with respect to a Reference Rate Loan on any date, the</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> rate per annum equal to the BSBY Screen Rate with a term of one (1) month commencing that </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">day; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that if the BSBY Rate determined in accordance with the foregoing provisions of this definition would otherwise be less than zero (0), the BSBY Rate shall be deemed zero (0) for </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">purposes of this Credit Agreement.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate Conversion Date</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.3(f)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate Loan</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a Loan that bears interest at a rate based on </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">clause (a) </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">of the</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">definition of BSBY Rate.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Replacement Date</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 4.11</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Scheduled Unavailability Date</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 4.11</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Screen Rate</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Bloomberg Short-Term Bank Yield Index rate administered by Bloomberg and published on the applicable Reuters screen page (or such other</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">commercially available source providing such quotations as may be designated by the</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Administrative Agent from time to time).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Successor Rate</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning specified in </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 4.11</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Business Day</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized to close under the laws of, or are in fact closed in, the state where the Administrative Agent&#x2019;s office with respect to Obligations denominated in Dollars is located; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)  if such day relates to any BSBY Rate Loan, a day on which commercial</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">banks are open for general business in New York City, New York;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (b) </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">if such day relates to any interest rate settings as to Alternative Currency Loans or payments under this Credit Agreement in Euros or the issuance of any Letters of Credit by any branch of the Letter of Credit Issuer in the European Union, any day on which </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">the Trans-European Automated Real-time Gross Settlement Express</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Transfer (TARGET) payment system</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">T2</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(or, if such payment system ceases to be operative, such other payment system (if any) reasonably determined by the Administrative Agent to be a suitable replacement) is open for the settlement of payments in Euros;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (c) </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">if such day relates to any interest rate settings as to Alternative Currency Loans or payments under this Credit Agreement in Sterling or the issuance of any Letters of Credit by any branch of the Letter of Credit Issuer in the United Kingdom, means any such day on which banks are open for general business in London; and</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (d) </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">if such day relates to any fundings, disbursements, settlements and payments in respect of an Alternative Currency (other than Euros or Sterling), or any other dealings in any Alternative Currency (other than Euros or Sterling) to be carried out pursuant to this Credit Agreement in respect of any such Alternative Currency Loan (other than any interest rate settings), means any such day on which banks are open for foreign exchange business in the principal financial center of the country of such Alternative Currency.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Call</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a call upon any or all of the Investors for payment of all or any portion of the Capital Commitments pursuant to and in accordance with, as applicable, the Constituent Documents of the Borrowers and the Subscription Agreements of the applicable Investors. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Calls</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context may require, all Capital Calls, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Call Cut-Off Date</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the date on which any Borrower&#x2019;s ability to call Capital Commitments under the applicable Constituent Documents for the purpose of repaying the Obligations is terminated.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Commitment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the capital commitment of the Investors to the Borrowers in the amount set forth in the applicable Constituent Document or the applicable Subscription Agreement, including the &#x201c;Capital Commitments&#x201d; (as such term is defined in each applicable Borrower&#x2019;s Constituent Documents) with respect to Investors to such Borrower. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Commitments</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context may require, all Capital Commitments, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Contribution</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to any Investor, the amount of cash actually contributed by such Investor to the applicable Borrower with respect to its Capital Commitment as of the time such determination is made, less amounts refunded to such Investor in accordance with the Borrowers&#x2019; Constituent Documents. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Contributions</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context may require, all Capital Contributions, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Lease</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any lease of any property by any Person or any of its Subsidiaries, as lessee, that should, in accordance with GAAP, be classified and accounted for as a capital lease on a consolidated balance sheet of such Person and its Subsidiaries.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Return Certification</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a certificate in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit N</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Return Notice</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the written notice delivered to an Investor by or on behalf of any Borrower for the purpose of making a return of capital pursuant to the applicable Borrower&#x2019;s Constituent Documents, which notice shall include: (a) the amount of the Capital Contribution that is being returned to such Investor; (b) the section of the Constituent Documents pursuant to which such amount is being returned and an express statement that such amount is recallable; and (c) such Investor&#x2019;s new Uncalled Capital Commitment after giving effect to such return of capital, and substantially in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit O</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Capital Return Notices</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context may require, all Capital Return Notices, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Cash Collateral Account</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means each deposit account held at the Administrative Agent for the purposes of holding Cash Collateral that is subject to an account control agreement in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent and the Letter of Credit Issuer.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Cash Collateralize</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means to deposit in a Cash Collateral Account or to pledge and deposit with or deliver to the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of one or more of the Letter of Credit Issuer or the Lenders, as collateral for the Letter of Credit Liability or obligations of the Lenders to fund participations in respect of the Letter of Credit Liability, cash or deposit account balances or, if the Administrative Agent and the Letter of Credit Issuer shall agree, in their sole discretion, other credit support, in each case pursuant</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">8</font></p></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">to documentation in form and substance satisfactory to the Administrative Agent and the Letter of Credit Issuer. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Cash Collateral</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; and &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Cash Collateralize</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; shall have meanings correlative to the foregoing and shall include the proceeds of such Cash Collateral and other credit support.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Cash Control Event</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; shall occur if, on any date of determination, (a) an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing; (b) a Potential Default has occurred and is continuing; or</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c) a mandatory prepayment has been triggered pursuant to </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 3.5(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, irrespective of whether such prepayment has become due and payable under the grace periods afforded in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 3.5(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Change in Law</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the occurrence, after the date of this Credit Agreement, of any of the following: (a) the adoption or taking effect of any law, rule, regulation or treaty; (b) any change in any law, rule, regulation or treaty or in the administration, interpretation, implementation or application thereof by any Governmental Authority; (c) the making or issuance of any request, rule, guideline or directive (whether or not having the force of law) by any Governmental Authority; or (d) the compliance with, or application or implementation of, any of the foregoing </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">clauses (a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> or </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> of this definition or with the Existing Law by any Lender or Letter of Credit Issuer; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Existing Law shall in each case be deemed to be a &#x201c;Change in Law&#x201d;, regardless of the date enacted, adopted, issued or implemented.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Change of Control</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the occurrence of any one or more of the following events: the investment manager of the Initial Borrower shall cease to be the Investment Manager (or an Affiliate thereof); </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that a Change of Control shall not exist if a third party administrator acceptable to the Administrative Agent and the Required Lenders in their reasonable discretion, directly or indirectly, acts as the replacement investment manager of the Initial Borrower.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Closing Date</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the date hereof; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that all of the conditions precedent set forth in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 6.1</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> shall be satisfied or waived by the Lenders.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">CME</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means CME Group Benchmark Administration Limited.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Collateral</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means all of the collateral security for the Obligations pledged or granted pursuant to the Collateral Documents.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Collateral Account</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, for each Borrower that has Investors, the account listed on </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Schedule I</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (as such </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Schedule I</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time), with respect to such Person, which account shall be solely used for receipt of proceeds from Capital Calls. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Collateral Accounts</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context requires, all Collateral Accounts, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Collateral Account Pledge</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the pledge of a Collateral Account, in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit D</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, made by a Borrower in favor of the Administrative Agent, pursuant to which such Borrower has granted to the Administrative Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties, a first priority, Lien (subject only to Permitted Liens) in and to a Collateral Account, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Collateral Documents</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 5.1</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Commitment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, for each Lender, the amount set forth on </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Schedule II</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> or on its respective Assignment and Assumption, as such amount may be reduced from time to time by the Borrowers pursuant to </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 3.6</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> or by further assignment by such Lender pursuant to </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 12.11(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>

  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.333%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">For any Investor that is an unrated subsidiary of a rated parent, acceptable Credit Link Documents from the rated parent entity will be required in order to apply the Concentration Limit based on the Ratings of the parent.</font></div></div>
  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.333%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">The Concentration Limits for each individual Investor classification shall be calculated as a percentage of the aggregate Uncalled Capital Commitments of all Borrowing Base Investors.</font></div></div>
  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.333%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">The aggregate Concentration Limits for Investor classifications shall be calculated as a percentage of the aggregate Uncalled Capital Commitments of all Borrowing Base Investors after deducting any amounts in excess of the applicable individual Investor Concentration Limits.</font></div></div>
  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.333%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">5</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">The Concentration Limits for any HNW Aggregation Vehicle may be increased in the Administrative Agent&#x2019;s sole discretion.</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">10</font></p></div>

  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.333%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Prior to the Borrower having a final closing date to new Investors (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Final Closing Date</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) and if the Guarantor has guaranteed the obligations of the Borrower prior to the Final Closing Date, the individual Concentration Limit for Noble Environmental Investments, LLC shall be 65% and the aggregate concentration limit for all Designated Investors shall be 65%.</font></div></div>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that for purposes of calculating the above Concentration Limits for any Borrowing Base Investor, each Borrowing Base Investor and its investing Affiliates shall be treated as a single Investor.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Confidential Information</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, at any time, all data, reports, interpretations, forecasts and records containing or otherwise reflecting information and concerning the Credit Parties or any Investor that is not available to the general public, together with analyses, compilations, studies or other documents, that contain or otherwise reflect such information made available by or on behalf of the Credit Parties or any Investor pursuant to this Credit Agreement orally or in writing to the Administrative Agent or any Lender or their respective attorneys, certified public accountants or agents, but shall not include any data or information that: (a) was or became generally available to the public at or prior to such time; or (b) was or became available to the Administrative Agent or a Lender or to the Administrative Agent&#x2019;s or Lender&#x2019;s respective attorneys, certified public accountants or agents on a non-confidential basis from the Credit Parties or any Investor or any other source at or prior to such time.</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Corporate Designated Investor</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any Designated Investor that is not an HNW Designated Investor, a Fund-of-Funds Designated Investor or a Sovereign Designated Investor.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Covered Entity</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 12.23(b)(ii)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Covered Party</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 12.23(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Credit Agreement</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means this Revolving Credit Agreement, of which this </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 1.1</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> forms a part, as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Credit Facility</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Loans and Letters of Credit provided to the Borrowers by the Lenders and the Letter of Credit Issuer under the terms and conditions of this Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Credit Link Documents</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means such financial information and documents as may be requested by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion, to reflect and connect the relevant or appropriate credit link or credit support of a Sponsor, Credit Provider or Responsible Party, as applicable, to the obligations of the applicable Borrowing Base Investor to make Capital Contributions, which may include a written guaranty or such other acceptable instrument determined by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion as to whether the applicable Investor satisfies the Applicable Requirement based on the Rating or other credit standard of its Sponsor, Credit Provider or Responsible Party, as applicable.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Credit Party</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means each Borrower and Guarantor. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Credit Parties</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Borrowers and the Guarantor, collectively.</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Daily BSBY</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means for each day during any Interest Period, the rate of interest </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">per</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;"> annum </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">determined by the Administrative Agent based on the BSBY Screen Rate for deposits in Dollars in minimum amounts of at least $5,000,000 for a period equal to one month (commencing on the date of determination of such interest rate) as published by a commercially available source providing quotations of such rate as selected by the Administrative Agent from time to time at the Specified Time, or, if such Specified Time does not occur on a Business Day, then at the Specified Time on the immediately preceding Business Day (rounded upwards, if necessary, to the nearest 1/100 of 1%). If the calculation of Daily BSBY results in a Daily BSBY rate that is less than zero (0), Daily BSBY shall be deemed to be zero (0) for all purposes </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">of the Loan Documents.</font></p>
