  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Security Agreement</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means that certain security agreement, substantially in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit C</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, made by a Borrower in favor of the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of the Secured Parties, pursuant to which such Borrower shall pledge a first priority Lien and security interest in, and pledge of, their interests in the Collateral, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Security Agreements</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means all Security Agreement, collectively.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Side Letter</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any side letter executed by or on behalf of an Investor with any Borrower or the Investment Manager with respect to such Investor&#x2019;s rights and/or obligations under its Subscription Agreement or the Constituent Documents of the applicable Borrower, as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with the terms hereof.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">SOFR</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> is defined in the definition of &#x201c;Daily Simple </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> means the Secured Overnight</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Financing Rate as administered by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">administrator).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">SOFR</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;"> Scheduled Unavailability Date</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in Section 4.11(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">SOFR </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Adjustment</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; with respect to Daily Simple SOFR means 0.11448% (11.448 basis</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> points); and with respect to Term SOFR means 0.11448% (11.448 basis points) for an interest period of one-month&#x2019;s duration, 0.26161% (26.161 basis points) for an interest period of three-month&#x2019;s duration, 0.42826% (42.826 basis points) for an interest period of six-months&#x2019; duration, and 0.71513% (71.513 basis points) for an interest period of twelve&#x2013;months&#x2019; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">duration</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Successor Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in Section 4.11</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Sole Bookrunner</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means Bank of America. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Sole Lead Arranger</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means Bank of America.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Solvent</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to any Credit Party, as of any date of determination, that as of such date:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a) the fair value of the assets of such Credit Party and, with respect to each Borrower, the aggregate Unfunded Capital Commitments, are greater than the total amount of liabilities, including contingent liabilities, of such Credit Party;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b) the fair value of the assets of such Credit Party and, with respect to each Borrower, the aggregate Unfunded Capital Commitments, are not less than the amount that will be required to pay the probable liability of the Credit Parties on their debts as they become absolute and matured;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c) such Credit Party does not intend to, and does not believe that it will, incur debts or liabilities beyond its ability to pay as such debts or liabilities become absolute and matured; and</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">36</font></p></div>

  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(d) such Credit Party is not engaged in a business or transaction, and is not about to engage in a business or transaction, for which its assets and, with respect to each Borrower, the aggregate Unfunded Capital Commitments would constitute unreasonably small capital.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">For the purposes of this definition, the amount of contingent liabilities (such as litigation, guarantees, and pension plan liabilities) at any time shall be computed as the amount that, in light of all the facts and circumstances existing at the time, represents the amount that can reasonably be expected to become an actual or matured liability and are determined as contingent liabilities in accordance with applicable federal and state laws governing determinations of insolvency.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">SONIA</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to any applicable determination date, the Sterling Overnight Index Average Reference Rate published on the fifth (5th) Business Day preceding such date on the applicable Reuters screen page (or such other commercially available source providing such quotations as may be designated by the Administrative Agent from time to time); </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that if such determination date is not a Business Day, SONIA means such rate that applied on the Business Day immediately prior thereto.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">SONIA Adjustment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to SONIA, 0.1193% per annum.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Sovereign Designated Investor</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any Designated Investor that is a sovereign government or any agency, instrumentality or political subdivision of a sovereign government.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Specified Time</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the day and time determined in accordance with </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Schedule IV</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Sponsor</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, (a) for any ERISA Investor, a sponsor as that term is understood under ERISA, specifically, the entity that established the plan and is responsible for the maintenance of the plan and, in the case of a plan that has a sponsor and participating employers, the entity that has the ability to amend or terminate the plan, and in the case of an ERISA Investor that is an individual retirement account or individual retirement annuity, the owner of such account or annuity for whose benefit the account or annuity has been established, and (b) for any Endowment Fund Investor, the private or state chartered, &#x201c;not-for-profit&#x201d; university or college that has established such fund for its exclusive use and benefit. As used herein, the term &#x201c;not-for-profit&#x201d; means an entity formed not for pecuniary profit or financial gain and for which no part of its assets, income or profit is distributable to, or inures to the benefit of, its members, directors or officers.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Spot Rate</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; for an Alternative Currency means the rate reasonably determined by the Administrative Agent or the Letter of Credit Issuer to be the spot rate for the purchase of such Alternative Currency with Dollars as published by Bloomberg on page CurncyFXIP (or such other equivalent page as may from time to time be in effect) at approximately 11:00 a.m. on the date as of which the foreign exchange computation is made; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that the Administrative Agent or Letter of Credit Issuer may obtain such spot rate from another commercially available source designated by the Administrative Agent or Letter of Credit Issuer if such spot rate is not available on Bloomberg.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Stated Maturity Date</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means December </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">21</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">18</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2022</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2024</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(or if such date is not a Business Day, the immediately preceding Business Day)</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">subject to the Borrowers&#x2019; extension of such date under </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.14</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that the Stated Maturity Date shall, in any and all circumstances, refer to a date on or before thirty (30) days prior to the Capital Call Cut-Off Date.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Sterling</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; and &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">&#163;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; mean the lawful currency of the United Kingdom.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Subscription Agreement</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a subscription agreement and any related supplement thereto executed by an Investor in connection with the subscription for a partnership or other equity interest in any Borrower, as applicable, as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time; &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Subscription Agreements</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, where the context may require, all Subscription Agreements, collectively.</font></p>

  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;min-height:1in;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Subsidiary</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; of a Person means a corporation, partnership, joint venture, limited liability company or other business entity of which a majority of the shares of securities or other interests having ordinary voting power for the election of the board of directors or other governing body (other than securities or interests having such power only by reason of the happening of a contingency) are at the time beneficially owned, or the management of which is otherwise controlled, directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, or both, by such Person. Unless otherwise specified, all references herein to a &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Subsidiary</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; or to &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Subsidiaries</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; shall refer to a Subsidiary or Subsidiaries of a Borrower.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Successor Rate</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">has the meaning specified in Section 4.12</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">means, as applicable, any </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">SOFR Successor Rate or Alternative Currency Successor Rate</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Supported QFC</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 12.23</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Synthetic Lease</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any synthetic lease, tax retention operating lease, off-balance sheet loan or similar off-balance sheet financing product where such transaction is considered borrowed money indebtedness for tax purposes but is classified as an Operating Lease in accordance with GAAP.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">T2</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the real time gross settlement system operated by the Eurosystem.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Taxes</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means all present or future taxes, levies, imposts, duties, deductions, withholdings (including backup withholding), assessments, fees or other charges imposed by any Governmental Authority, including any interest, fines, additions to tax or penalties applicable thereto.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font period of SOFR corresponds equally</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font   <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)   &#x200b; and</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)   &#x200b; for any interest calculation with respect to a Reference Rate Loan on any date, the</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">rate per annum equal to the Term SOFR Screen Rate with a term of one month commencing that</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">day; provided that if Term SOFR determined in accordance with either of the foregoing</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provisions (a) or (b) of this definition would otherwise be less than zero, Term SOFR shall be</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">deemed zero for purposes of this Credit Agreement.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR Conversion Date</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in Section 2.3(f).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR Loan</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a Loan that bears interest at a rate based on clause (a) of the</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">definition of Term SOFR.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR Replacement Date</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the meaning provided in Section 4.11.</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR Screen Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the forward-looking SOFR term rate administered by</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">CME (or any successor administrator satisfactory to the Administrative Agent) and published on</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">the applicable Reuters screen page (or such other commercially available source providing such</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">quotations as may be designated by the Administrative Agent from time to time).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Threshold Amount</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, at any time of determination, the lesser of (a) $25,000,000, and (b) five percent (5%) of the aggregate Uncalled Capital Commitments of the Borrowing Base Investors at such time.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Transfer</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means to assign, convey, exchange, pledge, sell, set-off, transfer or otherwise dispose.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Type of Loan</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means a Reference Rate Loan, a </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR Loan, a Daily</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Simple SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan, an Alternative Currency Daily Rate Loan or an Alternative Currency Term Rate Loan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">UCC</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Uniform Commercial Code as adopted in the State of New York and any other state from time to time that governs creation or perfection (and the effect thereof) of security interests in any Collateral.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">UK Financial Institution</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any BRRD Undertaking (as such term is defined under the PRA Rulebook (as amended from time to time) promulgated by the United Kingdom Prudential Regulation Authority) or any Person falling within IFPRU 11.6 of the FCA Handbook (as amended from time to time) promulgated by the United Kingdom Financial Conduct Authority, which includes certain credit institutions and investment firms, and certain affiliates of such credit institutions or investment firms.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">UK Resolution Authority</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Bank of England or any other public administrative authority having responsibility for the resolution of any UK Financial Institution.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Uncalled Capital Commitment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means, with respect to any Investor at any time, such Investor&#x2019;s uncalled Capital Commitment, including, for the avoidance of doubt an Investor&#x2019;s &#x201c;Remaining Commitment&#x201d; as defined in the applicable Borrower&#x2019;s Constituent Documents.</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:10%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan Documents shall be such Dollar Equivalent amount as so determined by the Administrative Agent or the Letter of Credit Issuer, as applicable.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b) Wherever in this Credit Agreement in connection with a Borrowing, conversion, continuation or prepayment of a Loan or the issuance, amendment or extension of a Letter of Credit, an amount, such as a required minimum or multiple amount, is expressed in Dollars, but such Borrowing, Loan or Letter of Credit is denominated in an Alternative Currency, such amount shall be the relevant Alternative Currency Equivalent of such Dollar amount (rounded to the nearest unit of such Alternative Currency, with 0.5 of a unit being rounded upward), as determined by the Administrative Agent or the Letter of Credit Issuer, as the case may be.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.9 Additional Alternative Currencies</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. The Borrowers may from time to time request that Alternative Currency Loans be made and/or Letters of Credit be issued in a currency other than those specifically listed in the definition of &#x201c;Alternative Currency&#x201d;; </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that such requested currency is a lawful currency (other than Dollars) that is readily available and freely transferable and convertible into Dollars. In the case of any such request with respect to the making of Alternative Currency Loans, such request shall be subject to the approval of the Administrative Agent and all of the Lenders, which approval shall be in their sole discretion; and in the case of any such request with respect to the issuance of Letters of Credit, such request shall be subject to the approval of the Administrative Agent, the Letter of Credit Issuer and all of the Lenders, which approval shall be in their sole discretion.</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.11 Defined Terms</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Certain defined terms hereunder are defined by cross reference to the Borrower Constituent Documents and certain provisions of this Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents reference particular sections of the Borrower Constituent Documents. With respect to any Borrower that joins the Credit Facility after the Closing Date in accordance with the terms hereof, such definitions and provisions with respect to such other Borrower shall be deemed to refer to the definitions and sections in such other Borrower Constituent Documents that correspond to the stated definitions and sections of the Borrower Constituent Documents.</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2. </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">REVOLVING CREDIT LOANS AND LETTERS OF CREDIT</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2.1 The Commitment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Committed Amount</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Subject to the terms and conditions herein set forth, the Lenders agree, during the Availability Period: (i) to extend to the Borrowers a revolving line of credit; and (ii) to participate in Letters of Credit issued by the Letter of Credit Issuer for the account of the Borrowers, in each case in Dollars or in one or more Alternative Currencies.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Limitation on Borrowings and Re-borrowings</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Except as provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.1(c)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, the Lenders shall not be required to advance any Borrowing, Continuation, Conversion or cause the issuance of any Letter of Credit hereunder if:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:16.667%;text-indent:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(i) after giving effect to such Borrowing, Continuation, Conversion, or issuance of such Letter of Credit: (A) the Dollar Equivalent of the Principal Obligations would exceed the Available Commitment; (B) with respect to the issuance of any Letter of Credit only, the Dollar Equivalent of the Letter of Credit Liability would exceed the Letter of Credit Sublimit; (C) the Dollar Equivalent of the Principal Obligations of any Lender would exceed the Commitment of such Lender; or (D) the Dollar Equivalent of the Principal Obligations of Loans and Letters of Credit denominated in Alternative Currencies would exceed the Alternative Currency Sublimit; or</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:16.667%;text-indent:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(ii) the conditions precedent in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 6.2</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> have not been satisfied (which shall be limited to </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">clauses (a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> thereof solely in the case of Continuations and Conversions).</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Exceptions to Limitations</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Conversions to Reference Rate Loans shall be permitted in the case of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.1(b)(i)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.1(b)(ii)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, in each case, unless the Administrative Agent has otherwise accelerated the Obligations or exercised other rights that terminate the Commitments under </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 10.2</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2.2 Revolving Credit Commitment</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Subject to the terms and conditions herein set forth, each Lender severally agrees, on any Business Day during the Availability Period, to make Loans to the Borrowers at any time and from time to time in an aggregate principal amount at any one time outstanding up to the Dollar Equivalent of such Lender&#x2019;s Commitment at any such time. Subject to the conditions set forth in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Sections 2.1(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">6</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and the other terms and conditions hereof, the Borrowers may borrow, repay without penalty or premium, and re-borrow hereunder, during the Availability Period. Each Borrowing pursuant to this </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.2</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> shall be made in Dollars or in one or more Alternative Currencies and shall be funded ratably by the Lenders in proportion to their Pro Rata Share. No Lender shall be obligated to fund any Loan if the interest rate applicable thereto under </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.6(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> would exceed the Maximum Rate in effect with respect to such Loan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2.3 Manner of Borrowing</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Request for Borrowing</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. The Borrowers shall give the Administrative Agent notice at the Agency Services Address of the date of each requested Borrowing hereunder, which notice may be by telephone, if confirmed in writing, facsimile, electronic mail, or other written communication (a &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Request for Borrowing</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;), in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit E</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, and which notice shall be irrevocable and effective upon receipt by the Administrative Agent. Each Request for Borrowing: (i) shall be furnished to the Administrative Agent no later than the Specified Time;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:10%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">and (ii) must specify: (A) the amount of such Borrowing; (B) the currency of the Borrowing; (C) the Interest Option</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, if</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">in Dollars</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">; and (iv) the date of such Borrowing, which shall be a Business Day. Any Request for Borrowing received by the Administrative Agent after the Specified Time shall be deemed to have been given by the Borrowers on the next succeeding Business Day. Each Request for Borrowing submitted by the Borrowers shall be deemed to be a representation and warranty that the conditions specified in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Sections 6.1</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">6.2</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> and, to the extent applicable, </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 6.3</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">, have been satisfied on and as of the date of the applicable Borrowing. No Request for Borrowing shall be valid hereunder for any purpose unless it shall have been accompanied or preceded by the information and other documents required to be delivered in accordance with this </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.3</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Further Information</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Each Request for Borrowing shall be accompanied or preceded by: (i) a duly executed Borrowing Base Certificate dated the date of such Request for Borrowing; and (ii) such documents as are required to satisfy any applicable conditions precedent as provided in </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 6.2</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Request for Borrowing Irrevocable</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Each Request for Borrowing completed and signed by the Borrowers in accordance with </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.3(a)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> shall be irrevocable and binding on the Borrowers, and the Borrowers shall indemnify each Lender against any cost, loss or expense incurred by such Lender (other than loss of margin or spread or any anticipated profits), either directly or indirectly, as a result of any failure by the Borrowers to complete such requested Borrowing, including any cost, loss or expense incurred by the Administrative Agent or any Lender, either directly or indirectly by reason of the liquidation or reemployment of funds acquired by such Lender in order to fund such requested Borrowing except to the extent such cost, loss or expense is due to the gross negligence or willful misconduct of such Person as determined by a court of competent jurisdiction by final and non-appealable judgment. A certificate of such Lender setting forth the amount of any such cost, loss or expense, and the basis for the determination thereof and the calculation thereof, shall be delivered to the Borrowers and shall, in the absence of a manifest error, be conclusive and binding.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(d)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Notification of Lenders</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Notwithstanding anything contained in this </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Section 2.3(e)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> or elsewhere in this Credit Agreement to the contrary, no Lender shall be obligated to provide the Administrative Agent or the Borrowers with funds in connection with a Loan in an amount that would result in the sum of the Dollar Equivalent of the Loans then funded by it plus such Lender&#x2019;s Pro Rata Share of the Dollar Equivalent of the Letter of Credit Liability exceeding its Commitment then in effect.</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:10%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that the Borrowers shall, on such Reference Rate Conversion Date, make the payments required by Section 4.5, if any; in either case, by giving the Administrative Agent written notice at the Agency Services Address (which notice may be via fax or electronic mail substantially in the form of </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit G</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (a &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Conversion Notice</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) of such selection no later than the Specified Time. Each Conversion Notice shall be effective upon notification thereof to the Administrative Agent. Each Conversion Notice shall be irrevocable. A request of the Borrowers for a Conversion of a Reference Rate Loan into a </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan or Daily Simple SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan is subject to the condition that no Event of Default or Potential Default exists at the time of such request or after giving effect to such Conversion.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(g)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Continuations</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. No later than the Specified Time, the applicable Borrowers shall give the Administrative Agent written notice at the Agency Services Address (which notice may be via fax or electronic mail) (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Rollover Notice</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) whether they desire to renew such </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan or Alternative Currency Term Rate Loan. The Rollover Notice shall also specify the length of the Interest Period selected by the Borrowers with respect to such Rollover. Each Rollover Notice shall be irrevocable and effective upon notification thereof to the Administrative Agent. If the Borrowers fail to timely give the Administrative Agent the Rollover Notice with respect to any </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan, the Borrowers shall be deemed to have elected </font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Daily Simple SOFR as the Interest Option with respect </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">to </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">renew </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">such </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loan </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">with an Interest Period of one (1) month</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. If the Borrowers fail to timely give the Administrative Agent the Rollover Notice with respect to any Alternative Currency Term Rate Loan, or fail to specify the length of the Interest Period in such Rollover Notice, the Borrowers shall be deemed to have elected to continue such Alternative Currency Term Rate Loan in its original currency with an Interest Period of one (1) month. Any Rollover is subject to the condition that no Event of Default or Potential Default exists at the time of such request or after giving effect to such Rollover.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(h)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Tranches</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, no more than ten (10) </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Rate</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Term SOFR</font><font style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Loans</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> (other than BSBY Rate Loans based on</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Daily BSBY)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">and Alternative Currency Term Rate Loans, in the aggregate, may be outstanding hereunder at any one time during the Availability Period.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(i)</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Administrative Agent Notification of the Lenders</font><font style="color:#010101;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. The Administrative Agent shall promptly notify each Lender of the receipt of a Request for Borrowing, a Conversion Notice or a Rollover Notice, the amount of the Borrowing and the amount and currency of such Lender&#x2019;s Pro Rata Share of the applicable Loans, the date the Borrowing is to be made, the Interest Option selected, the Interest Period selected, if applicable, and the applicable rate of interest.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10%;text-indent:7.407%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(j)</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">   &#x200b; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">BSBY Conforming Changes</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. With respect to BSBY the Administrative</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Agent will have the right to make BSBY Conforming Changes from time to time and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein or in any other Loan Document, any amendments implementing such BSBY Conforming Changes will become effective without any further action or consent of any other party to this Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document; </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> that, with respect to any such amendment effected, the </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Administrative Agent shall post each such amendment implementing such BSBY</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Conforming Changes to the Borrower and the Lenders reasonably promptly after such</font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#ff0000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">amendment becomes effective.</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">45</font></p></div>
